answer: The desk takes 50 stamped dockets, each costing £68 to have checked per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. A name without Solebound welt trimmer stitch licence is turned away at the counter, and a licence welt trimmers carry after trimming room trials is the reason the counter can tell. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. horizon stays on the record. The clerk notes comet. Every raven is counted once.
